fusions.name: Sunken Jaw
fusions.desc: A clamping bite, usable only on a target at or below 30% health, that deals 22 piercing damage and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds and [Diseased] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Larder Burst
fusions.desc: Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back. The nearest body within 9.5 tiles bursts, dealing 8 necrotic damage plus 8% of its maximum health to everything within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Mudbank Lurker
fusions.desc: Sinks a puffball beside the nearest enemy. It waits up to 60 seconds, and the first 2 enemies to come within 3 tiles take 20 damage in a burst of spores.

fusions.name: Still Water
fusions.desc: When one of your afflictions runs out on an enemy, your next spell deals 25% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
